providers.panel.grokAcpHint: Conversations run through `grok agent stdio` (Agent Client Protocol). Session resume and tool use use the host Grok login. The grok CLI loads its own machine-level config and memory (~/.grok — and demonstrably ~/.claude too); EYAS cannot disable this.
providers.panel.kimiAcpHint: Conversations run through `kimi acp` (Agent Client Protocol). Session resume and tool use use the host Kimi login. The kimi CLI may load its own machine-level config and memory; EYAS cannot disable or verify this.
providers.panel.loadClaudeMdHint: Load the host machine's Claude config into conversations — settings.json (hooks, permission rules), every CLAUDE.md tier, skills and project .mcp.json servers. Off by default: EYAS's own memory stays the single source of truth.
providers.panel.claudeMdWarning: CLAUDE.md instructions may conflict with EYAS system prompts (e.g. agent team format). If you experience issues, disable this setting or add to your CLAUDE.md:
